title: Store charge amounts precisely
body:
Charge amounts are `Float` columns today, and finance found a merchant whose December settlement was off by 0.01 after summing a few thousand captures. This moves the three amount columns on `charges` to `NUMERIC(12, 2)` and rounds incoming amounts to 2 dp in `create_charge`.

Migration rounds existing values in place. Ran it against a copy of prod: no row changes by more than 0.005.

Refunds table follows in a separate PR once this has been live for a few days.
author: carol

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+"""charges: amounts from float to numeric(12, 2)
+
+Revision ID: 0004
+Revises: 0003
+"""
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+revision = "0004"
+down_revision = "0003"
+
+COLUMNS = ("amount", "captured_amount", "refunded_amount")
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    for column in COLUMNS:
+        op.alter_column(
+            "charges",
+            column,
+            type_=sa.Numeric(12, 2),
+            postgresql_using=f"round({column}::numeric, 2)",
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    for column in COLUMNS:
+        op.alter_column("charges", column, type_=sa.Float())
